tasty.ex: The chocolate cake was really tasty.
tasty.pt: O bolo de chocolate estava muito gostoso.

suspect.ex: The little boy was our main suspect.
suspect.pt: O garotinho era nosso principal suspeito.

guilty.ex: He looked guilty when we asked about the cake.
guilty.pt: Ele parecia culpado quando perguntamos sobre o bolo.

innocent.ex: The dog was innocent; the kids ate the cake.
innocent.pt: O cachorro era inocente; as crianças comeram o bolo.

hilarious.ex: Her imitation of the dog was hilarious.
hilarious.pt: A imitação que ela fez do cachorro foi hilária.

joke.ex: Dad told a joke, but nobody laughed.
joke.pt: O pai contou uma piada, mas ninguém riu.

mess.ex: Who made this mess in the kitchen?
mess.pt: Quem fez esta bagunça na cozinha?

chocolate icing.ex: There was chocolate icing on his nose.
chocolate icing.pt: Havia cobertura de chocolate no nariz dele.

empty plate.ex: An empty plate was the only clue.
empty plate.pt: Um prato vazio era a única pista.

guilty face.ex: The puppy had a guilty face and wagged its tail.
guilty face.pt: O filhote tinha cara de culpado e abanava o rabo.

cake crumbs.ex: Cake crumbs covered the kitchen floor.
cake crumbs.pt: Migalhas de bolo cobriam o chão da cozinha.

family kitchen.ex: The family kitchen smelled of vanilla and butter.
family kitchen.pt: A cozinha da família tinha cheiro de baunilha e manteiga.

big mystery.ex: The missing cake became a big mystery.
big mystery.pt: O bolo sumido virou um grande mistério.

funny scene.ex: The funny scene made the whole audience laugh.
funny scene.pt: A cena engraçada fez toda a plateia rir.

hungry dog.ex: A hungry dog waited under the table.
hungry dog.pt: Um cachorro faminto esperava debaixo da mesa.
